assertions.name: headline_gap_equals_the_writhe_term_exactly
assertions.source: the pair the sibling probe reports as count-tied and energy-separated differs by exactly `(W1 - W2)*symmetricWeight q` = 2.0108968667071222998 -- i.e. by the writhe term and nothing else, which is `crossingEnergy_sub_eq_writhe_term_of_count_eq`

description: The owner objected that crossing COUNT is the wrong selection cost and proposed crossing ENERGY; a sibling probe measured that they disagree and left open when. Measured here: E_cross = n_plus*h + W/q exactly, so the energy is the count plus a writhe correction. The observable is a braid-ELEMENT invariant -- tr_M is constant on cyclic rotations (1.6e-61) and exactly unchanged by inserting a cancelling pair, which also makes a contiguous gluon's position immaterial -- while E_cross rises by exactly h under that same insertion, so the cost is a WORD functional. Over every equal-writhe pair the energy ordering and the count ordering coincide, so swapping the cost re-ranks only across writhe. Conclusion: the objection to the count is not answered by the energy; a genuine upgrade must not be a function of (n_plus, n_minus) at all. Adopts neither cost, selects no candidate, computes no Q_beta.
